summary: Per-frame vehicle physics update dispatched on a physics-mode selector (field this:0x32BC, cases 0-3 via jump table jpt_4F046E). Case 0 computes the wheel-space transform chain (delta-time velocity integration, sub_567120 small-rotation, F_3x3MatrixTransform), updates HUD elements 43/44, queries the body motion state, runs per-wheel collision/suspension geometry, and triggers vehicle sound based on an instance-id match. Case 1 is a velocity-threshold variant that falls through into case 2's shared integration; case 2 additionally integrates wheel torque and runs per-wheel suspension-parameter/vibration updates. Case 3 delegates to the physics time-step for the referenced vehicle. After the switch, SteeringForceWithRandom runs, and on a handled mode the vehicle state is updated with a 16-tick damping/flag governor.
